# Dōbutsu no Mori e+ PC/Android port v1.4.9

Version 1.4.9 of the port that runs [afe-decomp](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-decomp) (the どうぶつの森 e+ decompilation) on PC and Android.

## Changes since v1.4.8

A check of everything the keyboard does. Fixed:

- **A key held when a text screen opens no longer fills it.** Walking with W (or holding the A key) while a writing
  screen opened typed "ㅈㅈㅈㅈ..." until the key was let go: the key repeat of a key pressed before typing began.
  Such keys now type nothing until they are let go.
- **Password screens work with the keyboard.** In Korean mode the keyboard switched to typing there, but passwords
  take no typed text, so the keyboard did nothing at all on those screens, not even Start or B, unless you knew to
  press Tab. There the keyboard is now the controller, as on a gamepad.
- **The Korean keyboard's 한/영 and 한자 keys can be bound.** They (and the extra key of European keyboards and
  the Japanese keyboard's keys) have no name in SDL, so a control set to one showed "?" and was lost the next time
  the game started. They are now saved as `Hangul`, `Hanja` and so on.
- **F3 no longer changes the game speed when a control is set to it.** F3 turns the frame limit off and on (the
  game runs as fast as it can); with a control on F3, pressing that control did both.
- Start on a key such as Home finishing the text (v1.4.8) now applies to the game's buttons and sticks only, not
  to the map key.
- Signed with the same key as the previous version, so it installs over it (saves, the Korean patch and texture
  packs are kept).

## Updating

- **From v1.0.0 or later**, the game finds this version when it starts and offers to update (**Update now**; on
  Android, **업데이트** in the dialog). If GitHub answers with an error, try again a little later.
- v0.1.6 and earlier cannot update themselves: install this version by hand once.
- The multiplayer protocol is the same as v1.4.x's: v1.4.0 to v1.4.9 can be in the same room, and 32-bit and
  64-bit players can play together.

## Read this first

- **No game data is included.** You need your own disc image of the Japanese 「どうぶつの森 e+」 **Rev 1 (GAEJ01)**
  (`.iso` / `.ciso` / `.gcm`) to run it. Disc images are not distributed.
- **To play in Korean**, download the Korean patch from [retrodb 한글패치 — 동물의 숲 e+](https://retrodb.info/krpatch/7428/%EB%8F%99%EB%AC%BC%EC%9D%98-%EC%88%B2-e)
  and apply it in the game (pause menu → Settings → Disc → Korean patch → Install...). The Korean patch is the work of an
  independent author (역전맞고) unrelated to this repository.
- Multiplayer: [README](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/README.md#multiplayer). For players from
  other networks, the surest way is UPnP turned on in the host's router, or UDP 47070 forwarded to the host's device.

## Files

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.4.9-Windows-x64.zip` | 64-bit Windows. Includes `SDL2.dll`, requires OpenGL 3.3 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.4.9-Windows-x86.zip` | 32-bit Windows (also runs on 64-bit Windows). Includes `SDL2.dll`, requires OpenGL 3.3 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.4.9-Linux-x86_64.zip` | 64-bit Linux. Requires SDL2 (`libsdl2-2.0-0`) and an OpenGL 3.3 driver |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.4.9-Android.apk` | Android 5.0 or later, 32/64-bit ARM (armeabi-v7a, arm64-v8a) |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | SHA-256 of the files above |

## Verified

With real key presses sent to the game window (Linux):
- holding W while the message board's writing screen opened: before, it filled with ㅈ; after, nothing was typed,
  and typing afterwards worked ("dkssud" gave 안녕);
- on the password screen (Korean mode): before, D and Space did nothing; after, D moved the on-screen keyboard's
  cursor and Enter (Start) ended the screen;
- a control set to F3: before, F3 also turned the frame limit off; after, it only pressed the control;
- every key of the keyboard is saved under a name that reads back as the same key (511 of 511; before, 284 had no
  name);
- typing a notice, Backspace, Esc to the pause menu and back, Shift+Enter, and Start on Home: as before.

All unit tests pass. The decomp change is inside `TARGET_PC` only and the matching build's hashes are unchanged.
Android: the release-key signature (certificate `db6fc1ad…`) and the version (1.4.9, versionCode 10409).

## Known limitations

- On the first day, nothing can be saved before you have met a villager: the game itself does not allow it.
- In Korean mode, passwords cannot be entered: their characters are kana and symbols that the Korean patch's
  input has no keys for, and its font shows some pairs of them as one Hangul syllable. This is how the patch is
  made, also on the GameCube.
- The limitations of v1.4.3 remain (see its [release notes](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/releases/tag/v1.4.3)).

Build instructions and detailed progress are in [docs/README.md](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/docs/README.md).
